archival_memory.japan_trip: I had a fascinating trip to Japan during my junior year. I spent some time in Tokyo, exploring the tech hub and marveling at the futuristic arcades and electronics stores in Akihabara. I also enjoyed trying the delicious food, including ramen. After a few days in Tokyo, I headed to Kyoto, which had a completely different vibe. It was calm and historical, with many shrines and temples to visit. I even caught a glimpse of geishas walking down a side street in Gion. The sense of stillness and reverence in Kyoto left a lasting impression on me.
